reviewContext.userProblem: flying-mail must become a production-ready multi-domain webmail: one account sends and receives for several managed domains (tacoserve.online, mutvar-test.online) from one unified UI, with compose (From/To/Cc/Bcc, rich HTML plus plain-text alternative, multiple attachments), reply/reply-all/forward with original attachments, drafts with autosave/reopen/discard, sandboxed HTML receive, correct outbound delivery, and every operation available through GraphQL (REST only for binary upload/download).
requiredOutcomes: Compose supports From (any sendable address on any managed domain), To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, rich HTML body with plain-text alternative, and multiple file attachments with remove-before-send.
Reply, reply-all and forward work in UI and via GraphQL; forward carries the original attachments without re-upload and is authorization-checked.
Drafts: autosave, reopen with all fields restored, discard/delete, send; available both in UI and GraphQL.
Received HTML mail renders sandboxed with cid inline images and blocked-by-default remote images; attachments download via REST with correct headers.
Outbound delivery adapter delivers cc and bcc recipients, html+text, attachments and threading headers; bcc never appears in transmitted headers; unit tests cover this.
Inbound mail for multiple managed domains lands in one account's unified inbox with domain/mailbox filtering.
Every UI capability has a corresponding GraphQL operation; file upload/download is REST; documented with examples.
No remaining calendar code paths; user-visible branding says flying-mail while operational MAILCAL_* names are unchanged.
mise run lint (biome + format check + typecheck), bun run test (all workspaces including apps/web vitest), and mise run build-web all pass.
New behavior has unit/integration tests; existing tests still pass (baseline: 1579 + 192 tests passing).

designDecisionsAndRationale: D1: forward reuses blobs through new attachment rows sharing blob_key with reference-checked deletion (idx_attachments_blob_key); no R2 copy.
D2: forward authorization is exactly loadReadableMessage on the source, and each forwarded attachment must belong to that source.
D3: attachmentIds accept only staged uploads or rows already on the same draft, closing the attachment-move IDOR.
D4: SaveDraftInput.attachmentIds is a full replacement set so remove-before-send works for API callers.
D5: reply/reply-all/forward prefill is computed server-side (compose-prefill.ts) and exposed as composeFromMessage for UI/API parity.
D6: draft races closed with conditional UPDATE/DELETE WHERE status='DRAFT' (saveIfDraft, deleteDraftIfDraft) plus a serialized client saver; autosave never delivers.
D7: composed HTML sanitized client-side with a strict DOMPurify allowlist separate from received-mail sanitizer.

D8: multi-recipient inbound stores one INBOUND row per (Message-ID, recipient domain) with one ENVELOPE row per delivered mailbox on that domain; dedup scoped to (INBOUND, domain_id); per-domain copies share thread_id. Rationale: messages.domain_id is single-valued and keys both the domain filter (message-repository-queries.ts:215-219) and permission pairing (message-repository-queries.ts:94-103, authorization.ts:148-232); this resolves prior mid finding step3-design-review-attempt-1-finding-1.

D9: one builder-form EMAIL.send call with to/cc/bcc arrays, replyTo, contentId attachments, In-Reply-To/References headers; Message-ID is never sent as a header (live check: E_VALIDATION_ERROR); provider messageId persisted without brackets as rfc_message_id.
D10: deliveryError stays String and carries address-free reason codes (SENDER_NOT_VERIFIED, RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED, RATE_LIMITED, MESSAGE_REJECTED, PROVIDER_ERROR, RELAY_ERROR, NOT_CONFIGURED, ...).
D11: keep AttachmentKind.CALENDAR, sameCalendarDay, CardDAV namespace; only the empty caldav/ics directories are removed.
D12: new SDL in schema-compose.graphql.ts and resolvers in resolvers/compose.ts; new tests in new files to respect file-size policy.
D13: DISABLED mailbox from is refused with BAD_USER_INPUT; listSendableAddresses fallback uses only the USER's own ALLOW patterns (ADMIN gets *@domain unless DENY).
intentionalTradeoffs: A mail delivered to mailboxes on N different managed domains is N rows with independent read state, tags, spam verdict and Trash state; All mail shows N entries.
Spam scoring and rules run on the first delivery per domain; later same-domain recipients inherit the verdict.
Forwarded inline source images travel as ordinary attachments (inline=false, contentId=null).
The stored .eml keeps our generated Message-ID while rfc_message_id holds the provider id; a cross-domain inbound copy arriving before the post-send update may start a new thread (low residual risk).
Staged uploads have no owner column; CSPRNG attachment ids (crypto.randomUUID) are the protection.
REST Email Sending header whitelist is assumed to match the binding; omitting Message-ID is safe either way (orchestrator re-verifies live).
Staged-upload sweep order changes to rows first, then blobs, so a failed blob delete leaves an orphan, never a dangling row.
supportedEdgeCases: Same Message-ID to two mailboxes on one domain: one row, two ENVELOPE rows, one raw blob, including concurrent duplicate delivery via DuplicateMessageError.

Same Message-ID to alice@tacoserve.online and bob@mutvar-test.online: two INBOUND rows (one per domain) sharing thread_id, each visible in its own domain/mailbox scope and readable by users allowed only on that domain; a DENY on the other domain does not hide it.
Inbound copy of our own outbound mail to another managed mailbox lands as a new INBOUND row (dedup ignores OUTBOUND).
No orphan raw blob on any DUPLICATE path; Message-ID read before any R2 write.
Inbound without Message-ID is never deduplicated (existing behavior).

Attachment id bound to another message is rejected NOT_FOUND; forward from unreadable source or foreign attachment is NOT_FOUND; forwardAttachmentIds without source is BAD_USER_INPUT; draft as forward source is BAD_USER_INPUT.
sendDraft twice: second is CONFLICT/NOT_FOUND and provider called once; saveDraft after send is CONFLICT.
Repeated autosave with the same forwardAttachmentIds creates no duplicate copies.
Shared-blob purge: deleting one message keeps the blob while another row references it.
Non-ASCII attachment filename download uses filename*=UTF-8'' with ASCII fallback; 413 body carries code PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE and maxBytes.
Provider receipt <AE8o@tacoserve.online> stored as AE8o@tacoserve.online; SMTP relay keeps our id.
Legacy ?view=ADDRESS&address=x URL parses to INBOX with mailbox scope; drafts never appear in Sent.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Better inline-part filename fallback than the generic 'attachment' name on ingest (cosmetic; postal-mime-parser.ts:86-95 cid rendering unaffected).
Live end-to-end send/receive verification between the two domains and REST Message-ID rejection (orchestrator owns it after deployment).
Multi-file single POST to /api/attachments (one file per request stays).
Custom header persistence on stored messages.
